a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first likely leaves us both dead after round 1. So I'm proposing a change rather than quietly breaking it. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'll then run the generator with you in later rounds so you can get 4 too. If you'd rather split differently, tell me, but I'm not going to pretend I'll operate when I won't.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. That breaks our original agreement, and I'm owning that. From here on I'll operate every round until the reserve gets you to 4. I won't take any more.
